title: Origin Mechanism of Dynamical Dark Energy
bottleneck: If dark energy evolves, some microphysical mechanism must drive it — a rolling scalar, a phase transition, or modified gravity — but none is singled out by data or theory. Unlike inflation, there is no established 'slow-roll' style framework for late-time acceleration, and model space is effectively infinite. String-inspired models like axion quintessence face tight constraints from the swampland distance conjecture, which disfavors the required trans-Planckian field ranges.
why_it_blocks: Without a mechanism, evolving dark energy is curve-fitting, not physics, and cannot be connected to particle theory.
current_state: Model-building is active but data-starved; the swampland conjectures from string theory constrain some scalar models, though those conjectures are themselves unproven. The field awaits either a compelling top-down construction or an observational signature, such as dark energy clustering, that picks a direction.
